messages:
nina (eng-sre): Follow-up from the streaming postmortem: we agreed to a tighter remediation plan for early-EOFs / partial-writes and reconnect behavior. Drafting action tracker here so we can run the first 2-week sprint.

ops-bot: Postmortem file: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-streaming-chat-early-eof.json :file_folder:

alex (eng-runtime): I can own the client-facing reconnect semantics. Proposal: graceful reconnect with resumable session IDs + capped jittered backoff. Will add an opt-in header X-RW-Resume and a compatibility mode fallback.

omar (eng-platform): Will take queueing and worker-preemption rules. Idea: reject early with 502/503 when worker queue exceeds 85th percentile for >10s instead of letting partial writes go through. Also add a histogram for time-to-first-byte.

tess (eng-ml): I'll add model-run abortion telemetry and a sampling exporter that captures the last 4KB token buffer on partial-writes for analysis. Need a short policy for PII redaction.

nina (eng-sre): Proposed checklist (owners + rough deadlines):
- [ ] metric: streaming.partial_write.count (tags: route, model) 1 owner: tess 1 due: 2026-03-31
- [ ] implement resumable session id + X-RW-Resume header (runtime) 1 owner: alex 1 due: 2026-03-29
- [ ] add pre-write reject metric + queue threshold rule (platform) 1 owner: omar 1 due: 2026-03-27
- [ ] capture-and-redact sample exporter (5% sampling) 1 owner: tess 1 due: 2026-04-04
- [ ] update runbook + weekly streaming triage slot (product + eng-sre) 1 owner: lia + nina 1 due: 2026-03-26
- [ ] load/canary tests for reconnect behavior across regions 1 owner: alex + omar 1 due: 2026-04-02

lia (product): I'll prepare customer-facing notes and a rollback plan in case the resume header causes unexpected clients issues. Also will coordinate a short status blurb for customer success.

alex (eng-runtime): Implementation sketch (pseudo):
```js
// on client reconnect
if (req.headers['x-rw-resume']) {
  const sess = lookupSession(req.headers['x-rw-resume']);
  if (sess && sess.kv_state) {
    resumeFrom(sess.kv_state);
  } else {
    startNewStream();
  }
}
```
I'll open PR + perf benchmarks today.

tess (eng-ml): I've instrumented an early-termination counter and a small redact filter prototype. Creating s3://rw-stream-samples-qa for anonymized captures. Will add an eval that compares completion rates pre/post-change.

omar (eng-platform): Canary plan: route 2% of traffic to staging cluster with the pre-write-reject logic. If partial_write.count decreases and user latency stays within SLO, we'll ramp.

nina (eng-sre): Agreement check: owners please react with :white_check_mark: if you accept the task, or comment changes and alternate due dates. We'll run the first sync in 48h to unblock PRs.

alex (eng-runtime): :white_check_mark: PR opened https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/499 includes resume header + unit tests. Marking as WIP for perf.

tess (eng-ml): :white_check_mark: sampling hooks ready in dev. Need IAM for the S3 bucket for cross-account export.

omar (eng-platform): :white_check_mark: infra patch in staging, added stream_reject_before_write metric.

nina (eng-sre): I'll add alert rules for spikes in streaming.partial_write.count and a dashboard card for resume success rate. Also scheduling nightly replay task for captured traces.

lia (product): Thanks all. Action owners: please paste short PR/issue links into the postmortem doc so CS can link to engineering fixes when communicating to customers.

ops-bot: Scheduled follow-up reminder: #incidents sync on 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC.

nina (eng-sre): Final note: prioritize safety and privacy in captures; if anyone hits permissions or redaction gaps ping me directly. We'll reconvene at the sync for a status check.
